style.styleTitle: Homcom 2ft Prelit Small Christmas Tree With 35 LED Lights
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Light up your festive decor with the HOMCOM Small Christmas Tree! Enjoy a cosy, warm white glow from 35 pre-lit LEDs, powered by batteries for a mess-free, cable-free display. Adorned with snow-flocked branches, pine cones and berry clusters, this compact Xmas tree adds a charming winter feel to any space, all while ensuring safety with its flame-retardant branches.</p><ul><li>Pre-lit with 35 warm white LEDs for a festive glow;</li><li>Snow-flocked, dense branches with pine cones and berry clusters enhance festive atmosphere;</li><li>Flame-retardant branches ensure safety even near fireplaces;</li><li>Concrete-reinforced plastic base wrapped in linen-look fabric for stability and rustic charm;</li><li>Battery operation offers cordless convenience for placement anywhere;</li><li>Compact tabletop tree brings festive cheer to small indoor spaces;</li><li>Colour: Green, White;</li><li>Light Colour: Warm White;</li><li>Material: Plastic, Metal, Linen, Concrete;</li><li>Overall Dimension: F37 x 60H cm;</li><li>Base Size: F11 x 4H cm;</li><li>Tips Count: 72;</li><li>LED Light Count: 35;</li><li>Decoration Count: 6 (Pine Cone), 6 (Berry Cluster);</li><li>Suggest Shaping Time: 10 minutes;</li><li>Battery: 3 x AA Batteries (Not Included);</li><li>Item Label: 83C-121V01GN;</li></ul><p>NOTE: Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;</p>
